openings.claim: Repurpose confusion counting into paired baseline/candidate contribution ranges by slice for unresolved flagged labels, using a spreadsheet/local script. This changes provisional-label count dependencies to expose whether disputes can change further-evaluation decisions. Fixed predictions/slices remain; only selected sealed labels replace provisional labels. Differing predictions contribute conservatively within [-1,+1]; matching predictions contribute zero, without inventing labels.
openings.discriminator: Rival: separate baseline/candidate confusion tables with available labels. If unresolved rows can cross overall gain four or slice loss two, ranges return unresolved even when provisional counts pass. Advance if every compatible bound passes; reject if every jointly compatible possibility fails acceptance. Preserve joint compatibility; loose separate bounds may require unresolved. Advantage disappears when adjudication resolves every decision-relevant disagreement or the rival computes equivalent bounds.
openings.probe: Run matched copies within seventy minutes with independently reset sixteen-row allowances and the same predeclared flagged-ID order. Attempt four preselected withheld rows; log failures without allowance consumption. Adjudicate at most sixteen accessible rows per copy. Preserve used identifiers/labels, failures, allowance use and elapsed time in supplied records. Freeze reports before opening the sealed full-label key; compare decision support, affected slices and accounting. Test whether bounds expose uncertainty concealed by point counts.
openings.uncertainty: Four withheld rows can defeat certification. Sixteen adjudications and seventy minutes may leave unresolved; implementation feasibility is unmeasured. No guaranteed decision or measured benefit is asserted. Provisional observations do not establish the final decision; this review probe provides no deployment evidence.

lineage.reason: Preserves causal change, rival, complete decision/defeat conditions, probe, declared fit and resource/compatibility uncertainties.

decision: Retain D1 for bounded review using only supplied records and labels, without outside examples. Keep acceptance unchanged: overall improvement at least four and no slice loss above two. Report unresolved when the adjudication limit prevents support; account for every adjudication.
